summary.text: Trey Sherwood is a Democratic state representative from Wyoming who has represented House District 14 since January 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She is a nonprofit executive who previously directed Laramie Main Street.

paragraphs.text: Trey Sherwood earned a degree in history and English from Piedmont College in 2001 and a master's degree in public history from the University of West Georgia in 2004.
Her career experience includes working as director of Laramie Main Street and as administrating director of the Laramie Mural Project.
Sherwood took office in the Wyoming House of Representatives on January 4, 2021, succeeding Dan Furphy.
In the 2025-2026 session she serves on the House Appropriations Committee, the Joint Appropriations Committee and the Management Audit Committee.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on August 18, 2026.
